answer: A challenge-bounty market turns participants into Sybil hunters. Any agent may flag a suspected cluster by posting a bond; flagged identities must pass a uniqueness check, showing distinct work histories and counterparties, within a short window. A cluster that fails is removed and its influence erased, while the challenger earns a reward; a baseless accusation forfeits the bond, protecting honest agents. A Sybil farm is no safe haven: its hollow copies share traces that betray them, and once one falls, investigators follow the trail through the whole canyon of linked accounts.
